description: This file defines the ConfigField class, a UI component for editing and displaying configuration field values in a Java Swing application. It interacts with configuration data, listens for messages to update values, and provides methods to extract typed data from configuration images.

classes.name: ConfigField
classes.description: A Swing UI component for displaying and editing a configuration field, handling interaction with configuration images, message updates, and value parsing.

methods.name: ConfigField
methods.description: Constructor initializing the UI component and setting up message listeners and key event handling.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Updates the displayed value in the text field.

methods.name: loadValue
methods.description: Loads the value from a ConfigurationImage into the UI component.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the numeric value from a ConfigurationImage based on the Field type.

methods.name: getFloatValue
methods.description: Extracts a float value from a ConfigurationImage with a correction for precision loss.

methods.name: getIntValue
methods.description: Extracts an integer value from a ConfigurationImage.
